name: MTHPI
summary: MTHPI, also known as 3-(1-methyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrid-4-yl)indole (3-MTPI), is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tetrahydropyridinylindole group related to the psychedelic drug dimethyltryptamine (DMT). Though it is not technically a tryptamine itself, MTHPI can be regarded as a constrained analogue of DMT.

pharmacology.text: MTHPI, also known as 3-(1-methyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrid-4-yl)indole (3-MTPI), is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tetrahydropyridinylindole group related to the psychedelic drug dimethyltryptamine (DMT). The drug shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1, 5-HT1A, and 5-HT2A receptors (Ki = 217 nM, 144 nM, and 71 nM, respectively). Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was 8-fold higher than that of DMT.
